policy: Manual board audit after projection-context recalibration. Projection movement is evidence, not an automatic rank move. Decisions also consider Player Quality, ceiling, role, offensive environment, availability, reliability, positional scarcity and 1-QB draft strategy.

decisions.name: Lamar Jackson
decisions.reason: Elite projection and Player Quality rise are real, but QB opportunity cost in a 1-QB/short-bench format already keeps him behind comparable RB/WR/TE targets; no need to chase a +20.5 PPR model swing with an Overall move.

decisions.name: Malik Willis
decisions.reason: Projection fell materially to 230 and the profile remains QB24 with sample-size/environment concerns. In a 1-QB format he should sit behind stronger late-QB options and usable skill-position darts.

decisions.name: Parker Washington
decisions.reason: Projection fell 14 PPR, Player Quality slid five spots, ceiling remains modest and there is an active day-to-day injury watch. Role keeps him relevant, but 60 is now too aggressive.

decisions.name: Rashee Rice
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Strong to Very Strong and Player Quality moved 23 to 19. Knee ramp-up prevents a larger move, but the production/role/environment profile supports a small rise.

decisions.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Moderate to Solid and Player Quality improved six spots. Current rank should reflect the stronger production baseline while still respecting role/competition uncertainty.

decisions.name: Jonathon Brooks
decisions.reason: Projection lost 13.25 PPR, Player Quality fell four spots and availability/role confidence remain weak. Historical context did not support the prior placement.

decisions.name: Kyren Williams
decisions.reason: Projection rose to 276 with a three-spot Player Quality gain; strong role and environment justify a modest bump, not a major reshuffle.

decisions.name: Rachaad White
decisions.reason: Projection gained 12 PPR, but role-split uncertainty caps the move. Small rise only.

decisions.name: Malik Nabers
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Solid to Strong and Player Quality improved, but ACL/meniscus recovery keeps the move intentionally limited.

decisions.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Moderate to Solid, but major lower-body recovery risk still limits confidence.

decisions.name: Chuba Hubbard
decisions.reason: Projection rose 11 PPR and Player Quality improved four spots. Hamstring status prevents a larger move.

decisions.name: Brenton Strange
decisions.reason: Projection lost 10.75 PPR and Player Quality fell five spots. Role is still good, so this is a controlled downgrade.

decisions.name: Tee Higgins
decisions.reason: Projection improved, but current Overall placement already appropriately reflects strong production with lower availability/reliability than nearby targets.

decisions.name: Deebo Samuel
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Concern to Moderate and Player Quality rose three spots, but role/health uncertainty keeps him in the late range.

decisions.name: Chris Olave
decisions.reason: Projection dropped from Very Strong to Strong and Player Quality slipped. Conditional health/context watch supports a modest downgrade.

decisions.name: David Montgomery
decisions.reason: Projection gained 9.25 and Player Quality improved three spots; role and environment remain supportive.

decisions.name: Jakobi Meyers
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Moderate to Solid and Player Quality jumped eight spots. The larger quality move justifies a meaningful but still controlled Overall bump.

decisions.name: Derrick Henry
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Very Strong to Elite. Role and ceiling remain strong enough for a two-slot rise despite age-related sustainability concerns.

decisions.name: Mike Evans
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Solid to Strong and Player Quality improved five spots. Age/availability keep the move modest.

decisions.name: Saquon Barkley
decisions.reason: Projection improved and Player Quality moved five spots, but existing workload/age risk means only a one-slot improvement is warranted.

decisions.name: DJ Moore
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Solid to Strong and Player Quality improved four spots; strong environment and low bust profile support a small rise.

decisions.name: Alvin Kamara
decisions.reason: The +8 PPR change is a per-game historical correction, not a reason to erase the current Grade 2 MCL injury, weak role score, low ceiling and FADE/AVOID profile.

decisions.name: Jordan Addison
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Moderate to Solid. The change is meaningful enough for a small rise but not enough to override the rest of the profile.

decisions.name: Tyler Shough
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Strong to Solid. In a 1-QB format the reduced production outlook warrants a small slide.

decisions.name: Rashid Shaheed
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Concern to Moderate; move is limited because the overall profile remains volatile.

decisions.name: Isaiah Likely
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Solid to Moderate. TE upside remains, so only a modest downgrade.

decisions.name: DK Metcalf
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Moderate to Solid and Player Quality improved four spots. Current rank is slightly too low after recalibration.

decisions.name: Sam Darnold
decisions.reason: Projection fell to Solid, but he is already deeply discounted by 1-QB strategy. Further movement would have little practical draft impact.

decisions.name: Dak Prescott
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Strong to Very Strong and the existing profile already supports him as a value QB. 1-QB strategy caps the move at five spots.

decisions.name: Patrick Mahomes II
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Very Strong to Elite. Positional opportunity cost prevents a large rise, but 78 is too low for the revised production tier.

decisions.name: Kyler Murray
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Strong to Very Strong. He remains a late-QB option, but the revised production outlook warrants moving him ahead of the weakest late-round darts.

decisions.name: Colston Loveland
decisions.reason: Small projection decline crossed a raw production threshold, but TE positional scarcity, role, ceiling and environment still justify the current placement.

decisions.name: Trevor Lawrence
decisions.reason: A 3.25-point decline barely moved the projection below the Elite cutoff. The broader profile did not materially worsen, so no Overall change.

decisions.name: Bo Nix
decisions.reason: Projection crossed Very Strong to Elite. QB opportunity cost still matters, but the current slot is too low relative to the revised production outlook.

decisions.name: KC Concepcion
decisions.reason: Only a 2.25-point change. The tier flag is threshold noise rather than a meaningful player-profile change.

decisions.name: CeeDee Lamb
decisions.reason: Only a two-point projection change. No meaningful board signal.

decisions.name: George Pickens
decisions.reason: Only a two-point projection change. No meaningful board signal.
